financial_anchor.caveat: Q3 FY2026 margin benefited materially from tariff refunds, so it is not normalized

ai_claim.claim: AI is deployed across analysis, decision support, automation and robot control, including commercially integrated radiology applications.
ai_claim.scope: Named portfolio capabilities, not full installed base
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled multi-site throughput, paid attach or cash bridge

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Diagnostics revenue fell 5.5% comparably in Q3 and margin improvement was aided by tariff refunds; customer data ownership and rival imaging platforms constrain capture.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Diagnostics weakness reflects China and platform transition rather than disproving imaging AI

rights_limit: Hospitals/patients own or control most clinical context. Installed access permits scoped inference; cross-site training and reusable outcome rights remain contract/consent dependent.
materiality_summary: 5% of FY2025 IFRS EBIT is €157.7m. Illustrative cost and revenue break-even bridges are below/unproven.

arithmetic.result: €157.7m annual EBIT hurdle, requiring €225.3m incremental revenue at assumed margin

g2_provisional: Limited: E2 product deployment exists, but controlled quality-adjusted throughput and retained economics are absent.
unresolved_questions: What share of installed scans uses each AI feature?
What paid attach, renewal and model costs apply?
